firebase-common.author: emilypgoogle
firebase-common.message:
Removed usage of deprecated GMS Objects class (#8551)

The GMS Objects class is no longer recommended for usage and we are
getting downstream edits to source because of it. Fixes the problem at
the sources and moves to `java.util.Objects` for relevant calls.

firebase-crashlytics.author: Matthew Robertson
firebase-crashlytics.message:
Added consumer rules to prevent R8 missing-class warnings (#8567)

Added consumer ProGuard rules to prevent R8 missing-class warnings for
`ProfilingManager` and `ProfilingTrigger` on older compileSdk versions

firebase-crashlytics-ndk.author: Matthew Robertson
firebase-crashlytics-ndk.message:
Remove norelro linker flag to enable RELRO (#8566)

Removed the `norelro` linker flag to enable Relocation Read-Only (RELRO)
across Crashlytics NDK binaries, making relocation sections read-only
after loading to mitigate security exploits

Verified by running `llvm-readelf -l "$f" | grep GNU_RELRO` for each
binary, see https://paste.googleplex.com/5633939205652480

This increases each file size by only 120–200 bytes per binary

Tested manually on a physical device
